comment: The plugin is on the census skip list: instantiating either model crashes the scan, so there are no scanned positions and every position used here was read out of the ModuleWidget constructor in src/Module.cpp. The installed build is 2.1.15 and the shipped commit is c372f06. The crash is visible in the code: LFMModuleWidget's constructor calls glfwInit and glfwCreateWindow to open a second operating-system window and then builds a WindowedProjectMWidget which starts a projectM render thread; it also stores the ModuleWidget in the window's user pointer through reinterpret_cast<WindowedRenderer*>, which is not that type. PARAM_GRADIENT (index 6) and GRADIENT_INPUT (index 7) are configured on the shared LFMModule class and read every frame in step(), but this widget places no knob and no jack for either, and the panel art carries no GRADIENT lettering; both are left untagged and without a line. The three memory-free jacks beside the knobs carry no lettering on the panel. No Frames is on the panel menu only where ARCH_MAC is undefined, and it is absent from the installed build, so it is left out.
